name: An Infinite Point in Time
source:
This is the story of a first date and its lasting aftermath.
Presented in the style of a visual novel, the reader will be required to participate in the story. There are two possible endings based on the reader's actions.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22818]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个关于初次约会，以及它留下的长久影响的故事。
故事以视觉小说的形式呈现，读者需要参与其中。根据读者的行动，故事会迎来两种不同的结局。

［摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22818]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]］
